verdict.line: You lose if you facetank her Q poke and passive sustain before level 6 and before Sunfire Aegis; you win once her W (Hallowed Mist) is on cooldown and you can land a full Q into R combo without her vanishing.

brief.thesis: Gwen's passive (A Thousand Cuts) deals bonus magic damage based on your current health and heals her off it, which directly punishes K'Sante's health-stacking identity. Her W (Hallowed Mist) means she can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist, so every one of your targeted tools — Q's pull, W's stun, R's knockback — whiffs unless you're willing to walk into it. The matchup is decided by whether you can force fights while her mist is down.

theirWindow.what: She can pop it mid-trade or during your W (Path Maker) charge-up and go untargetable to anything you cast from outside it. Do not spend Q's pull, W's stun, or R's knockback here — back off and reset instead of committing into an active mist.

yourWindow.when: her W (Hallowed Mist) just went down
yourWindow.what: With Hallowed Mist on its 18-22s cooldown she has no untargetability and no escape besides E (Skip 'n Slash). This is when you land Q (Ntofo Strikes) for the 2-stack pull and chain straight into R (All Out).

powerCurve.note: Her Q poke and passive sustain win extended trades
Your R threatens all-ins, hers adds burst/slow
Q/W/E cooldowns shrink, tank core comes online
Full build and 80s R uptime outscale her damage

start.why: The extra HP and passive block blunt her Q pokes and passive true damage while you're still one item behind.

boots.why: Tenacity and magic resist directly counter her on-hit magic damage from E and the slow from her R (Needlework).

core.why: The damage spike and slow let you actually punish her once Hallowed Mist is down instead of just tanking hits.
Health plus armor and magic resist together directly answers her mixed true/magic poke and lets you win extended trades.
Stacking magic resist and the move speed passive let you close the gap on her before she can Skip 'n Slash away.

situational.when: her passive healing from A Thousand Cuts is keeping her alive through your trades
she has snowballed and her E attack speed window is chunking you in extended fights
you need more raw magic resist and your own sustain is falling off

runes.keystoneWhy: The bonus health and sustain from proc'ing on trades offsets her Q poke and passive drain better than a damage keystone you can't consistently land through her mist.

summoners.why: Teleport lets you reset off her early poke advantage without losing waves, and Flash covers you if she baits a knockback or slow near a wall.

playing.title: Charge W to eat pokes
playing.detail: K'Sante takes reduced damage while charging Path Maker; time the charge-up to absorb an incoming Q snip instead of standing in it raw.

playing.title: Never commit CC into fresh mist
playing.detail: If her W is up, don't spend Q's pull, W's stun, or R's knockback — anything cast from outside a fresh Hallowed Mist simply won't land on her.

playing.title: All-in the moment her E is down
playing.detail: Skip 'n Slash (13/12.5/12/11.5/11s cooldown) is her only dash and attack-speed steroid; committing right after she uses it removes her best disengage.

playing.title: Use Q stacks to lock her in
playing.detail: Ntofo Strikes grants a stack on hit and pulls enemies in at 2 stacks — land this early in a trade so the pull resolves before she can Skip 'n Slash out.

playing.title: Track her mist cooldown all lane
playing.detail: At 18-22s cooldown it's down often enough by level 9+ that you'll get clean windows to full-combo her without a vanish.

playing.title: Itemize magic resist, not just health
playing.detail: Her Q center hits deal true damage and her passive scales off your current health, so raw HP stacking alone won't cap her damage — get Force of Nature online.

playing.title: Teleport to reset, not to force fights
playing.detail: You lose most pre-6 skirmishes to her poke and sustain; use Teleport to trade waves and hold priority rather than forcing an all-in you can't win yet.

brief.patchCaveat: Item and rune names reflect the standard K'Sante tank build as of my last update (patch context around 16.18) — verify Trinity Force, Sunfire Aegis, and the Resolve keystone options still exist under these exact names before finalizing the build in-client.
